solution_files.leap.ml:
(* A year is a leap year if it divides by 4, but not by 100 unless it divides by 400. *)
let leap_year year =
  let divisible_by n = year mod n = 0 in
  divisible_by 4 && (not (divisible_by 100) || divisible_by 400)
